title: Bring your clients from another system

steps.caption: Import
steps.narration: Moving from another system? Bring your client list with you, from one spreadsheet file.

steps.caption: Clients first
steps.narration: Start with Clients. Estimates and invoices come after, and attach to those clients.

steps.caption: A CSV or TSV export
steps.narration: Export your list from the old system as a CSV file, then choose it here.

steps.caption: Choose the file
steps.narration: This demo file holds six clients.

steps.caption: Preview
steps.narration: Choose Preview. Nothing is saved yet.

steps.caption: 6 rows, all valid
steps.narration: Six rows were read, and all of them are valid.

steps.caption: The column mapping
steps.narration: The CRM guessed which column is the name, the email, the phone and the address.

steps.caption: Fix a column
steps.narration: Open a list to fix one that looks wrong, or leave it on skip.

steps.caption: The rows as they will be saved
steps.narration: Underneath, you see every client as it will be saved.

steps.caption: Import 6 rows
steps.narration: When it looks right, choose Import.

steps.caption: 6 created
steps.narration: Six created. A client you already have, by email or phone, is skipped, not doubled.

steps.caption: The new clients
steps.narration: The new clients are in your list, each with its contact details and address.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: To come back to the import page, choose Import, here on Clients.

youtube.title: How to import your clients from a spreadsheet | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Move your client list into the ConstructHUB CRM from a CSV export. Choose the file, preview it, check which column is which, and import. Clients you already have are skipped instead of duplicated. Recorded in a demo workspace with made-up clients.
